chapter: Early career: vaudeville and Kansas City
title: The Whitman Sisters, and first returning East with Bennie Moten
summary: Basie says the Whitman Sisters ran a road show that was not important to him, and that he came East again only with Moten's band and later again with his own in 1936.

story.theme_name: Medicine shows, minstrels, circuses and the black theater circuit
story.community_name: On the road with minstrel, carnival and tent shows
